statements.impact_statement: braces 3.0.3 is used only by build and dev tooling: micromatch under semantic-release, stylelint, eslint-config-next and Docusaurus, and chokidar 3 under Docusaurus and webpack-dev-server for file watching. It only expands glob patterns from project or tool config, so an attacker cannot supply the deeply nested patterns that cause the stack overflow. No published CALM package passes user input to braces. No patched braces release exists yet.

statements.impact_statement: http-cache-semantics 4.2.0 is used only as a private client cache: by make-fetch-happen inside the npm CLI that semantic-release uses at release time and under @npmcli/arborist in the license-checker-rseidelsohn dev tool, and by got and cacheable-request under the Docusaurus update-notifier. The attack needs a shared cache that serves cached responses to other users, with attacker-controlled request headers. No CALM component runs a shared HTTP cache, and no published CALM package includes http-cache-semantics at runtime. No patched release exists yet.

statements.impact_statement: postcss-selector-parser is used only by build and dev tooling: 6.1.4 by the cssnano plugins that Docusaurus uses to minify CSS, and 7.1.4 bundled inside the npm CLI that semantic-release uses at release time. Both parse only the project's own CSS at build time, so an attacker cannot supply the selectors that cause the slow parse. No published CALM package includes postcss-selector-parser at runtime. The fix is only in 7.1.6: there is no 6.x fix, and npm overrides cannot reach bundled dependencies.
